1.title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted
1.summary: The strikes come nearly a week after fighting between the US and Iran flared again following weeks of relative calm.

2.title: What the War in Iran Has Cost One Gold Star Family
2.summary: First Lt. Tyler James Feehan, who was 25, had been deployed to an air base in Jordan when enemy missiles and drones lit up the sky. He is among the 18 Americans who have died since the war began.

3.title: Trump Officials Draft Plan to Pay At-Home Parents, Using Funds for Working Ones
3.summary: The proposed benefit, a top policy priority for Vice President JD Vance, would apply only to married couples and tap a fund intended to provide federal child care subsidies to working parents.

4.title: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow for Ukraine talks
4.summary: Footage shows Vladimir Putin greeting Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, before saying the current situation "is not so easy".

5.title: Putin Meets Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow to Discuss Ukraine War
5.summary: President Vladimir V. Putin ordered a pause in strikes on Ukraine’s capital, Kyiv, ahead of the meeting with President Trump’s envoys: his son-in-law Jared Kushner and the businessman Steve Witkoff.
